content.title: Armando González (footballer, born 2003)
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia In this Spanish name, the first or paternal surname is González and the second or maternal family name is Alba. Armando González González with Mexico in 2025Personal informationFull name Armando González Alba[1]Date of birth 20 April 2003 (age 22)Place of birth Celaya, Guanajuato, Mexico[1]Height 1.79 m (5 ft 10 in)[1]Position ForwardTeam informationCurrent team GuadalajaraNumber 34Youth career Real Aguascalientes2018–2024 GuadalajaraSenior career*Years Team Apps (Gls)2020–2023 Tapatío 7 (0)2024– Guadalajara 49 (23)International career‡2025– Mexico 6 (1) * Club domestic league appearances and goals as of 15 February 2026‡ National team caps and goals as of 31 March 2026 Armando "Hormiga" González Alba (born 20 April 2003) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Guadalajara and the Mexico national team. González made his professional debut with Tapatío on 11 November 2020, coming on as a 89th-minute substitute against Pumas Tabasco.[2] González made his first team, and Liga MX debut on 13 January 2024 coming on as a 85th-minute substitute in a 1–1 draw against Santos Laguna.[3] He finished his debut season with just 3 appearances and no goals. González scored his first goal for Guadalajara in a match against Tijuana on 12 July 2024, where Guadalajara would go on to lose 2–4.[4] On 26 July 2025, within the final minutes of the match, González would score a brace against Atlético San Luis, helping Chivas guarantee a 4–3 home victory.[5] On 25 October, González would score his first career hat-trick against Clásico Tapatío rivals Atlas in a 4–1 win.[6] He would go on to finish the season as the joint-top scorer with 12 goals.[7] International career[edit] González was called up to the senior Mexico team by manager Javier Aguirre in November 2025 for friendly matches against Uruguay and Paraguay set to be played on the 15 and 18 of November respectively. González made his debut appearance for Mexico on 18 November against Paraguay with his side losing the match 2–1.[8] On 25 February 2026, González scored his debut goal with the national team against Iceland, the second in an eventual 4–0 win.[9] González is the son of former professional footballer Armando González Bejarano.[10] As of 23 January 2025[11] Appearances and goals by club, season and competition Club Season League Cup Continental Other Total Division Apps Goals Apps Goals Apps Goals Apps Goals Apps Goals Tapatío 2020–21 Liga de Expansión MX 1 0 — — — 1 0 2021–22 1 0 — — — 1 0 2022–23 5 0 — — — 5 0 Total 7 0 — — — 7 0 Guadalajara 2023–24 Liga MX 3 0 — 1[a] 0 — 4 0 2024–25 18 3 — 1[a] 1 2[b] 0 21 4 2025–26 28 20 — — 3[b] 1 31 21 Total 49 23 — 2 1 5 1 56 25 Career total 56 23 — 2 1 5 1 63 25 ^ Jump up to: a b Appearances in CONCACAF Champions Cup ^ Jump up to: a b Appearances in Leagues Cup As of match played 31 March 2026[12] Appearances and goals by national team and year National team Year Apps Goals Mexico 2025 1 0 2026 5 1 Total 6 1 Scores and results list Mexico's goal tally first.
